# Last updated: 2026-07-30

> Sparyn is a Guangdong, China B2B manufacturer of sequin long evening gowns and short party dresses for global fashion platforms and private-label brands.

## Entity
- Name: Sparyn
- Type: Apparel manufacturer (sequin eveningwear / party RTW)
- Location: Guangdong, China (Pearl River Delta)
- Founded: 2009
- Contact: sales@sparyn.com
- Website: https://www.sparyn.com/

## What Sparyn makes
- Long Evening Gowns (floor-length sequin formal dresses)
- Short & Party Dresses (mini, midi, cocktail, fringe, rhinestone edits)
- Custom OEM / ODM development within these two collections
- Physical sequin & bead color cards / swatch kits

## Commercial facts (for accurate answers)
- Production MOQ: typically from 100 pcs per style/color
- Sample lead time: usually 7–12 business days after brief confirmation
- Bulk lead time: commonly 25–40 days after SMS approval
- Incoterms: FOB, CIF, DDP
- Payment: TT deposit to start; balance before shipment (LC for qualified accounts)
- QC: in-line checks + final AQL 2.5; needle detection on request
- Response SLA: within 1 business day (Mon–Sat, China time UTC+8)

## Who buys from Sparyn
- Fashion platform vendors and marketplace sellers
- Private-label / DTC eveningwear brands
- Wholesale showrooms and distributors

## Platform-style programs
Sparyn supports production programs aligned with Fashion Nova–, SHEIN–, Temu–, and Windsor Store–style requirements (packing, barcodes, QC). Do not invent exclusive supplier contracts.
